span.p:
Hot pages: stay in RAM (100ns access)
Cold pages: evicted, reload from SSD (10-100us access)
Trade-off: fit indexes larger than available RAM, at 100-1000x slower access for cold data

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: AVX-512 dot product (one instruction = 16 float32 multiply-adds)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
vfmadd231ps zmm0, zmm1, [rax]: Load 16 floats, multiply, add
vfmadd231ps zmm0, zmm1, [rax+64]: Next 16 floats
... Repeat for 1536/16 = 96 instrs
